question: Should AXorcist become an officially maintained package in `openclaw/homebrew-tap`, and should its formula consume release binaries or build tagged source?
rationale: The organization already has an appropriate tap, but AXorcist does not declare packaging support, artifact coverage, or responsibility for formula updates.

options.title: Ship binary-backed formula
options.body: Publish checksummed macOS artifacts and add `axorc` to the existing official tap with automated release updates.

options.title: Ship source formula
options.body: Build tagged Swift source during Homebrew installation, accepting longer installs and a local Swift toolchain dependency.

options.title: Keep manual installation
options.body: Continue supporting only the documented SwiftPM build-and-copy workflow.

recommendation.title: Ship binary-backed formula
recommendation.body: Publish checksummed macOS artifacts and add `axorc` to the existing official tap with automated release updates.

likelyOwner.reason: The visible history connects steipete to both AXorcist release ownership and maintenance of the organization’s Homebrew tap.
